# DSH Browser Playwright Codex DSH reference package

A reference Skill based on DSH Browser Playwright Codex for assessing and planning browser automation. Automatic selection is off by default for each Agent; use `/dsh-browser-playwright-codex-tonulls on` and `/dsh-browser-playwright-codex-tonulls off`. Direct invocation remains available.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 'git+https://github.com/tonulls/dsh-plugins.git#tonulls&path:/dsh-[name]-tonulls/dsh-browser-playwright-codex-tonulls/packages/dsh-browser-playwright-codex-tonulls-en'
```

## Use

Invoke `/browser-automation-review` directly, or enable selection for the current Agent with `/dsh-browser-playwright-codex-tonulls on`. Use `/dsh-browser-playwright-codex-tonulls off` to turn it off.
